|errata_history=This is the original printing of “Ord Mantell (V)” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 1): the card image in place when Virtual Set 24 was officially released (30 December 2024), first published 26 December 2024. This is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image first published 26 December 2024<ref name="ht-3d2c89e">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/hires/ordmantell.png as uploaded] (high-resolution PNG) to the PC's Holotable image repository in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1 3d2c89e] “Set 24 New Cards”, 26 December 2024; the card-size GIF copy (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) followed the same day in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d64059dd1b272bb73e7c5e8e8f001036fd2a5524 d64059d].</ref>, before the set's official release (30 December 2024), prints: “’’’Light Side:’’’ Your smugglers and [Independent] starships deploy -1 here.

’’’Dark Side:’’’ Your [Independent] starships may move here as a ‘react.’ Once per game, if you control, may take Death Mark into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
*: On 29 December 2024 the PC re-uploaded the same card image turned 180°<ref name="ht-3152726">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/hires/ordmantell.png as uploaded] (high-resolution PNG) to the PC's Holotable image repository in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f 3152726] “Ord Mantell rotation fix”, 29 December 2024; the card-size GIF copy (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) followed on 30 December 2024 in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/36f17f9 36f17f9].</ref>: the first upload prints the Light Side half right way up at the bottom (margin “Ord Mantell (Dark)” at bottom left) and the Dark Side half upside down at the top; the re-upload prints the Dark Side half right way up at the bottom and the Light Side half upside down at the top. Turned back, the two images are pixel-for-pixel the same, with the same words, so they are one version (a 180° turn is not a version; Bill, 23 November 2026). The image on this page is the re-upload.

Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 February 2025, with the same words ([[:File:V24-D-ordmantell-2025-02-02-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on this page.
